objects.taxonomy_description: Time-telling device designed for wall mounting with a circular face 20-40 cm in diameter. Face features hour numerals (Arabic, Roman, or markers) arranged in a 12-hour circle. Two or three hands (hour, minute, second) rotate from the center. Frame is wood, metal, or plastic in various finishes (oak, black, white, brass). Mounting bracket or keyhole slot on the back. Quartz movement powered by a single AA battery. Glass or plastic crystal covers the face. Some models have a pendulum visible below the face. Overall depth is 5-10 cm.

objects.taxonomy_description: Asian proboscidean measuring 250-300 cm at shoulder weighing 3000-5000 kg. Body massive with thick wrinkled gray-brown skin and sparse body hair. Head broad with twin-domed skull. Ears relatively small compared to African elephant. Trunk (proboscis) elongated and muscular with single finger-like projection at tip. Tusks present primarily in males, shorter than African species. Body barrel-shaped with arched back. Legs pillar-like with five toenails on forefeet. Tail long with terminal tuft. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart.

objects.taxonomy_description: Fleet equine mammal measuring 120-150 cm at withers with distinctive black-and-white striped coat pattern. Stripes unique to each individual, extending across body, legs, and mane. Head elongated with large dark eyes and mobile ears. Neck arched with erect bristly mane. Body robust and muscular. Legs long and slender terminating in single dark hooves. Tail long with black tufted hair. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse body hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. African equine with herd behavior. Stripes serve as camouflage and fly deterrent.
